_ApiBaseUrl: Empty means same origin as the Blazor WASM document base (the recommended setup for the self-hosted Docker image). Set to an absolute URL like "https://api.example.com/" only when the API and the Blazor WASM client are served from different origins.

Serilog._comment: Browser-side Serilog. ClientLogEndpoint is resolved against builder.HostEnvironment.BaseAddress (so the default points at the API on the same origin). Override here only if the API is hosted on a different origin from the WASM client.

Features._comment: Client-side feature toggles read by the Blazor WASM app via IConfiguration. Each toggle is opt-in: the default is OFF and the feature is hidden from the UI. Flip a toggle on when the matching server-side capability is in active use; the UI will reveal the controls. Server-side behaviour (API, region guard, migration) is unaffected — these flags only gate Web UI exposure. See docs/operations/06-configurable-subsystems.md#experimental-features for the full rationale.
